gameLoopReview.loopTightness: Strong: moment-to-moment movement, shooting, dashing, perks, shops, and escalating waves are already reinforced by deterministic flow-field navigation.
gameLoopReview.progressionCurve: Strong with one remaining leap: formation identity deepens late-wave pressure, while the deterministic replay runner remains the next mastery/trust milestone.
gameLoopReview.sessionEngagement: Strong: DeathScreen now closes the weekly-contract loop immediately after a run, when replay motivation is highest.
gameLoopReview.retentionHooks: Strong: rivalry, ghost, contract, daily seed, and leaderboard loops are present; the next lift is proving them through analytics credentials and real traffic.
gameLoopReview.soulFidelity: Good: readable chaos, parody-first identity, and fast retry loops remain intact while the systems become more deterministic.

items.item: Enemy navigation is still a large inline App.jsx island even though replay Phase 2B needs deterministic movement primitives.
items.recipe: Move FF_CELL, buildFlowField(), and flow-field sampling into src/systems/flowField.js, wire App.jsx through the helpers, and add tests for obstacle blocking plus fallback steering.
items.evidence: src/systems/flowField.js owns buildFlowField() and sampleFlowField(); src/App.jsx imports the helpers; src/systems/flowField.test.js covers path steering, obstacle routing, and fallback-null behavior.

items.item: The wave director names pressure stages, but individual spawns still arrive as unrelated edge enemies.
items.recipe: Add a deterministic formation planner to waveDirector, tag scouting/pressure/climax spawns as flank/pincer/surge patterns, apply small post-spawn offsets in App.jsx, and cover the planner with unit tests.
items.evidence: src/systems/waveDirector.js exports deterministic formation plans plus bounded post-spawn offsets; src/App.jsx applies them to director spawns; src/systems/waveDirector.test.js covers pincer identity and bounds clamping.

items.item: Weekly contracts and bounty loops live in Run History, but the post-run screen is where motivation is highest.
items.recipe: Reuse buildWeeklyContract() on DeathScreen, render one compact Next Contract panel under Run Brain, and add a social-retention regression for contract progress copy.
items.evidence: src/components/DeathScreen.jsx builds the active weekly contract from run history/rivalries/studio events and renders its progress under Run Brain; src/utils/socialRetention.test.js covers latest progress labels.

items.item: Trace bodies now reach submit-score, but the edge contract caps event count rather than encoded byte size.
items.recipe: Add a trace body byte cap and reason to collectTraceFailures(), mirror the cap in client trace constants if needed, and document the measurement target in the validation log.
items.evidence: src/utils/replayCommandTrace.js exports a 10,000-byte trace body budget and rejects oversized traces; supabase/functions/submit-score/index.ts rejects trace bodies over the same encoded budget before storage.

validation.targeted: 22/22 focused audit tests passed before closeout.
validation.fullTests: npm test passed: 357/357 tests across 44 files.
